svg.title: How a search works. One query fans out to two answers on one page. A quick explanation from Wikipedia. Eight top papers from OpenAlex, with authors, year, journal, a short abstract, citation count and free PDF links when available; example results from the screenshot for predictive coding include The Predictive Coding Account of Psychosis (Sterzer, Adams, Fletcher and others, 2018, Biological Psychiatry, 854 citations, free PDF). Sort by most relevant, most cited, newest, or reviews only. One click buttons: Explain with Claude, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, lectures, and focus on this. Optional extra tabs: Google Scholar, PubMed, PsyArXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenNeuro, SEP and YouTube. Press slash anywhere to jump to the search box.
